nass.notice: NASS Quick Stats national monthly series: average table-egg layer inventory, egg-type pullet placements, and egg-type chicks hatched. A value is hidden until its load_time, which is the database load time interpreted as US Eastern time, not the reference month. Quick Stats returns the current row, so a later reload is not a point-in-time revision history. Missing rows stay empty and are then carried forward only after they have loaded.
